value.body: I logged in to [Tangled](https://tangled.org), and clicked into a post under "Announcements" block on the right of the page, which took me to [a post on Tangled Blog](https://blog.tangled.org/bobbin). In the top-right corner, however, it shows "Login or [Join Now ->]". I clicked "Login", and in the following page I tried both clicking my profile card under "Saved Accounts" and manually typing my handle, but both just takes me back to Tangled homepage, and if I go to Tangled Blog again, it still shows "Login or [Join Now ->]".
value.title: Tangled Blog not recognizing login status
